# THUMBNAIL.md — Unseen America (test fixture)

Thumbnail grammar for this channel. Language and boundaries, never a template.

## Visual grammar

Destination and scenic: one place read instantly. A street, a skyline, a road into distance, a landmark seen from an unusual angle.

## Typography

A short place name is welcome: a clean geometric sans, bold enough to read on a phone, one or two words.

## Text

Text preferred when it names the place. Never a slogan.

## Colour direction

Warm, believable daylight or blue hour from the footage. Contrast may be lifted; colour is never replaced.

## Subject emphasis

The place itself: architecture, road, landmark, landscape. Water is welcome when the place has it and never required.

## Composition

Leading lines: a road, a river of light, a street. Horizon placed deliberately. One subject, one direction.

## Acceptable layout families

Full-bleed frame. Full-bleed frame with a place name. Split frame of two views of the same place.

## Avoid

Faces. Arrows. Fake skies. Cloned competitor framing. Landmarks that do not appear in the film.
